name: Tasklist (SA)
help: List running processes with PID, PPID, session ID and command line via WMI
long_help: Queries Win32_Process via WMI to list all running processes. Returns Name, ProcessId, ParentProcessId, SessionId, and CommandLine. Can query local or remote systems.

arguments.name: resource
arguments.desc: WMI resource path, e.g. \\.\root\cimv2 (local) or \\HOST\root\cimv2 (remote). Empty for local default
